text:
maria: Drafting the rollout playbook for FlashAttention v2 -> v3 kernel selection. Please review flags, probes, and rollback.

devin: main concerns?

maria: quick list:
- ordering and deterministic fallback
- paged-attn vs fused-attn kv behavior
- batching heuristics for short/long mixes
- quantized kernel regressions (int4/int8)
- memory fragmentation on long-context

kai: ran microbench on p4d test bed:
```
model: redwood-7b
seq=256 bs=1: v2=8.9ms, v3=6.7ms (-25%)
seq=3072 bs=1: v2=68ms, v3=72ms (+6%)
v3 peak_mem ~ +10% in steady-state
```
notes: v3 good for typical chat but worse at extreme lengths, and int4 fused kernel spikes on page churn.

sarah: do we have an automated KV-frag stress test? the 3k+ long convo broke canary last time.

maria: infra-bot: kick nightly kv-frag job on v3 branch.

infra-bot: job started: ci-kv-frag-2026-03-19-01 on pool=dedicated-c. will update when complete.

devin: proposed flags:
- runtime.attn_kernel.prefer_v3 (bool)
- runtime.attn_kernel.fallback_on_oom (bool)
- runtime.attn_kernel.seq_window_pct (int) # use recent percentile instead of static cutoff
- runtime.attn_kernel.exempt_quant (list) # e.g., ["int4"]
- runtime.customer.<id>.attn_kernel override

kai: recommend seq_window_pct heuristic. hard thresholds hurt mixed workloads.

maria: rollout plan:
1) land selection behind prefer_v3=false
2) run CI bench matrix across models/seqs/batches/quant
3) enable prefer_v3=true on canary fleet (5%) with fallback_on_oom=true and exempt_quant=["int4"]
4) monitor latency p95/p99, OOMs, KV evictions, and eval deltas
5) expand to 25% then 100% if green; otherwise rollback

sarah: concrete alerts?
- attn.latency.p95 > +15% for >10m
- attn.latency.p99 > +25% for >10m
- attn.oom.rate > 5/min sustained 5m
- kv.evictions > baseline*1.5 for 15m
- model.eval.fail_rate > 1% on core prompts

devin: add rollback SLA: any alert flips prefer_v3=false for cohort and triggers 24h postmortem.

maria: ops snippets for runbook:
```
# toggle prefer_v3 for cohort
curl -XPOST https://flags.redwood/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"runtime.attn_kernel.prefer_v3","cohort":"canary","value":false}'
# enable fallback-on-oom globally
curl -XPOST https://flags.redwood/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"runtime.attn_kernel.fallback_on_oom","value":true}'
```

kai: pushing a probe harness to exercise prefill + long-chaining KV scenarios. will include int4 stress.

infra-bot: job finished: ci-kv-frag-2026-03-19-01 status=warning. 2/12 scenarios had memory spikes. logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/ci-kv-frag-2026-03-19-01/log

maria: kai, can you triage the two failing cases?

kai: reproducing locally. both failures on seq=4096 int4 with paged-attn fallback path. fragmentation leads to allocation failures under sustained prefill.

sarah: mitigation: set runtime.attn_kernel.exempt_quant=["int4"] by default during rollout. add int4 stress job before enabling.

devin: ok short-term. long-term we should fix allocator patterns or change paged-attn chunking.

maria: updated checklist:
- [ ] infra job artifacts
- [ ] kai probe PR + repro notes
- [ ] feature flags + API docs
- [ ] dashboards + alerting
- [ ] canary cohort config
- [ ] rollback playbook

maria: timeline: land behind flags today, quick smoke EOD, canary tomorrow for 24h, widen next week if green. will post bench artifacts and a billing impact note.

devin: +1. please tag me and attach the perf artifacts.
